$comment: The shared contract for notInUse(). agent-cockpit's api/lib.js and agent-team-template's scripts/lib/knowledge.mjs make this judgement twice, mirrored by hand because there is no import path between a student's repo and a deployed web app. arming-parity.json exists for the same reason and for the same pair of files; this one covers the other mirrored judgement, which did not have it, and was wrong in both copies at once. Same bytes in both repos, run by both sides: change one implementation alone and that side fails.

guidance.$comment: The paragraph both knowledge files ship, trimmed to the part that matters. It QUOTES the refusal as an example, which is what made a fully answered file read as a refusal. Note the <name> placeholder: that, not the punctuation, is what marks this as text nobody has answered.
guidance.sales:
**If you do not sell, say so here and stop.** Replace the first marker with something like
*"I do not sell - I work for this business and the selling is <name>'s job"*, delete the rest of
the file's markers, and you are done.
guidance.customerService:
**If the customers are not yours, say so here and stop.** Replace the first marker with
something like *"I do not deal with customers - I work for this business and support is
<name>'s"*, delete the rest of the file's markers, and you are done.
